items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] All right. I’m going to be careful how I look at my drummer tonight. You know I was talking to Phil Wilson about you. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh wow.

ctx.x: Yeah. Except, you know and Max Roach tried to change that a bit because the bass player would continue walking the changes of the tune on some of those recordings and Max would play over that, which is like saying hey, you know, I get a bass line too. But the majority of drum solos, I mean that’s a chance for the guys to go to the bar. So when I have my group, my little groups that I put together down here, I’ll tell the rest of the band, “Play behind me the same way you play behind a horn solo.” And I say to the…
All right. I’m going to be careful how I look at my drummer tonight. You know I was talking to Phil Wilson about you.
